mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (indicated by industrial production below 100.0), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% over the past 3 months signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a labor market slowdown, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (indicated by GDP growth above 2.0% annualized), consumer spending accelerates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0%.
